title: Agent Run
description: A log record for a single agent execution.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the run started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the run completed.

report_produced.description: True if the run produced a report (status was not 'no-change').

report_id.description: The run_id from the associated report record, if one was produced.

error_message.description: Error message if status is 'error' or 'partial'.

sources_checked.description: Number of sources checked during this run.
